mapper.sql: select d.drawing_id, d.customer_id, d.contract_id, d.drawing_name, d.drawing_type, d.file_url, d.file_name, d.version, d.is_current, d.status, d.confirm_user_id, d.confirm_time, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.remark, u.nick_name as confirm_user_name, c.customer_name, ct.contract_amount as contract_amount from biz_drawing d left join sys_user u on u.user_id = d.confirm_user_id left join crm_customer c on c.customer_id = d.customer_id left join biz_contract ct on ct.contract_id = d.contract_id
mapper.select: select max(version) from biz_drawing where drawing_name = #{drawingName} and ifnull(customer_id, 0) = ifnull(#{customerId}, 0) and ifnull(contract_id, 0) = ifnull(#{contractId}, 0)
mapper.update: update biz_drawing set is_current = '0', update_time = sysdate() where drawing_name = #{drawingName} and ifnull(customer_id, 0) = ifnull(#{customerId}, 0) and ifnull(contract_id, 0) = ifnull(#{contractId}, 0) and is_current = '1'
mapper.insert: insert into biz_drawing (customer_id, contract_id, drawing_name, drawing_type, file_url, file_name, version, is_current, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{customerId}, #{contractId}, #{drawingName}, #{drawingType}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{version}, #{isCurrent}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete:
delete from biz_drawing where drawing_id in
